items.description: No immediate reports of casualties, significant damage
items.author: Merve Aydogan
items.excerpt: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck 22 kilometers (14 miles) west-northwest of Ondores in Peru's central Junin region on Friday, according to the US Geological Survey. The quake took place at 7.09 pm local time (0009GMT Saturday) at a depth of approximately 142.1 km (88 mi).
